findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_supplements" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find the Aviado id for a supplement name, exactly (no fuzzy matching). Answers with matches[0] = the identity: vocabulary_exact, or user_intent for salt/form na…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
